references.text: Describes how the children of Israel marched out by their armies, as they were organized in the camp
Summarizes the journeys (מַסְעֵי) of the children of Israel from Egypt, using the same terminology for journeys/marches
The Lord brought the children of Israel out of Egypt by their armies (לְצִבְאֹתָם)
Mentions the children of Israel by their armies who were to be led out of Egypt
The preceding text describing the order of the tribes when they broke camp
